slots.name: passenger trips
slots.sentence: According to Pittsburgh Regional Transit, the agency recorded more than 39 million passenger trips during fiscal year 2026, the highest annual ridership total in six years.

slots.name: ridership growth
slots.sentence: Average weekday ridership in June also increased nearly 10% compared to the previous year.
